decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 27 November 2006, the erection of single storey rear extension, that extends across the full width of the ground floor to a depth of 2.9m, with a mono-pitched roof that has a maximum height of 3.4m, and increases the volume of the original house by less than 50m3, as shown on drawing numbers; AD 051 Pr B 20-11-06: Proposed Ground Floor, AD 051 Pr B 20-11-06: Proposed First Floor, Proposed Loft, Proposed Front & Rear Elevation, Proposed Side Elevation 1 and Proposed Side Elevation 2, received 27 November 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the erection of the single storey rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
